$comment: Top-level request fields on the ticket-bound chat completions lane. Platform (apps/platform/ditto/api_server/endpoints/inference.py) and the model relay (services/model-relay/internal/inference/schema.go) each have a test asserting their field sets equal this table exactly; refused reasons are the text the 400 returns. Any field not listed is refused with 400 "unsupported inference parameter: <names>". Explained in docs/MINER.md#inference-request-contract.

forwarded_value_limits.stream: only false is accepted; true is refused because this lane answers with a single non-streaming response

pinned.best_of: removed; the provider is always asked for exactly one completion (must still be an integer >= 1)
pinned.include_reasoning: removed so the pinned reasoning exclude=true cannot be overridden
pinned.max_completion_tokens: folded into max_tokens and clamped down to the ticket output ceiling
pinned.max_tokens: clamped down to the ticket output ceiling (must be an integer >= 1)
pinned.n: forced to 1 (must still be an integer >= 1)
pinned.prompt_cache_key: removed; shared provider cache buckets would allow cross-miner interference
pinned.reasoning: replaced with the benchmark reasoning block: fixed medium on v7/v8; from v9 the agent may choose low, medium, or high (default medium); exclude is always true
pinned.reasoning_effort: from v9 canonicalized into reasoning (must agree with reasoning.effort when both are sent), then removed; ignored before v9
pinned.service_tier: removed; a priority tier is compute the ticket did not grant
pinned.usage: removed; trusted cost comes from the provider response usage block

dropped.metadata: stripped; identifies the agent to a third party and never affects the completion
dropped.preset: stripped; the platform pins the provider route
dropped.provider: stripped; the platform pins the provider route
dropped.route: stripped; the platform pins the provider route
dropped.safety_identifier: stripped; identifies the agent to a third party and never affects the completion
dropped.store: stripped; contradicts the pinned no-retention posture
dropped.stream_options: stripped; only meaningful with stream: true, which is refused
dropped.user: stripped; identifies the agent to a third party and never affects the completion

refused.audio: this lane serves text completions only
refused.modalities: this lane serves text completions only
refused.models: the model is pinned by the ticket, not chosen by the request
refused.plugins: server-side plugins are not available on this lane
refused.top_logprobs: logprobs is supported but top_logprobs is not: it would exceed this lane's response size limit
refused.transforms: prompt transforms would change benchmark semantics
refused.web_search_options: server-side web search is not available on this lane
